hints.title: Prefix Sharing Structure
hints.text: Every prefix of every word can be shared. A prefix tree structure naturally groups and counts identical prefixes.

hints.title: Trie Node Visit Counters
hints.text: Insert each word into a prefix tree. On each visited tree node, increment a counter tracking how many words share that prefix.

hints.title: Prefix Score Accumulation
hints.text: For each word, walk its characters through the tree and sum the counters of all nodes encountered along the path.

hints.title: Prefix Tree Score Accumulation Implementation

variables: sum(len(word)): total length of all words
complexity.notes: Inserting all words and querying scores takes linear time in total character count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise prefix comparisons take O(n^2 * L) where L is max word length.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix tree stores character branches with visit counters for direct prefix lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Constructs trie with node passing counts to accumulate prefix scores in linear time.
